name: Shiny monster
notes: Opens after a victory screen, only when that win made a monster shiny (new_shiny is 0 or more). The new shiny monster's portrait bobs in the middle of a night sky, shimmering through the rainbow, with stars spraying out from behind it, under A SHINY MONSTER! and over its name and what being shiny gives it (+10% power on its moves, +20% starting HP). It shows the monster even if it is still locked on the menu. When it starts it makes the monster shiny for good (its slot of 'shiny' = 1, one more in 'shinies'), starts the count toward the next one over (shiny_count 0, every run in shiny_runs can count again) and saves, then a sparkling jingle plays. The victory song keeps playing. START goes back to the menu.
